content:
Class RegexMatch definition and execute method showing unvalidated regex_pattern input.

Post-context evidence: Confirms RegexMatch class accepts unvalidated regex_pattern via IO.STRING without length/complexity limits. Pattern passed directly to re.search() with no timeout or backtracking protection. Multiline flag increases attack surface. No upstream validation found. ReDoS risk remains valid.
recommendation: Add input validation for regex_pattern length and string length. Consider using a library like regex with timeout support or implementing a regex complexity limit (e.g., maximum recursion depth or pattern length).
